services.desc: Gather your crew and set out on the Halifax River aboard a spacious 13-passenger deck boat! With access to hidden gems like Disappearing Island, scenic sandbars, dockside restaurants, and the iconic Ponce Inlet Lighthouse, your day on the water is completely open-ended and self-guided. Cruise to boat-only fishing spots, anchor off sandy shores for a swim, or enjoy a picnic on a public island. services.name: Jetski Tour
services.desc: Experience the perfect blend of adrenaline and natural beauty on our all-new guided jet ski tour. Whether you are a seasoned rider or a first-time driver, this dynamic excursion is designed to showcase the very best of the Halifax river at every speed. Led by our expert local guides, your journey begins with a relaxed, low-speed cruise through our most picturesque waterways. This gentle start gives you time to get comfortable on your Yamaha 3 seat watercraft while gliding past stunning riverfront architecture, lush shorelines, and local marine life.
